answer_1.quote: We present Mix and Match Language Models (M&M LM), a training-free framework for controlled text generation ... We generate 560 sequences of different lengths ...
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences and revised sentences with controlled attributes

answer_2.quote: We use a variety of evaluation metrics to compare our approach's performance on two major facets: (1) Quality of generated text, and (2) success on matching the target attribute used for control.

answer_3.quote: We feed our generated test sentences to a Huggingface pre-trained GPT-2 xl model, and report its perplexity (PPL), as an automatic measure of fluency.

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk for our evaluations, where each HIT was a two choice question of "which sentence is more fluent?" and the providers were paid $0.1 per HIT.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers were asked to compare two sentences and select the more fluent one.
